BACKPROPAGATION · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Make a prediction → measure the error → send feedback backward

The network calculates a prediction on the forward pass, then traces how each trainable parameter affected the loss. The optimizer uses those gradients to learn.

questions.stem: Deep Learningలో Backpropagation అంటే ఏమిటి? Neural Network Prediction Errorsని Identify చేసి Learningకి Help చేసే Gradient Computation ఎలా Work చేస్తుంది?
options: Backpropagation Inputని Forwardగా Run చేసి Network Layer Count Choose చేస్తుందంటుంది. అవి Prediction, Design Tasks; Gradient Calculation కాదు.
Backpropagation Weights, Biases Changes Lossని ఎలా Affect చేస్తాయో Gradients Calculate చేస్తుంది; Optimizer Trainingలో Update చేస్తుంది.
Final Predictionని New Inputగా Backward Send చేస్తుందంటుంది. Derivatives లేకుండా Weight Corrections Determine కావు.
Wrong Predictionsని Memoryలో Save చేసి Next Time Search చేస్తుందంటుంది. Stored Results Alone Parameters Learn చేయవు.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Tomorrow Solar Panel Output 12 Units అని Neural Network Predict చేసింది; Actual Output 9 Units అనుకుందాం. “Wrong” అన్న Message కంటే Modelకి More Feedback అవసరం. Loss Function Difference Measure చేస్తుంది. Backpropagation Each Trainable Weight, Bias Change చేస్తే Loss ఎలా Affect అవుతుందో Calculate చేస్తుంది. Those Calculationsని Gradients అంటారు. Optimizer Gradients Use చేసి Parameters Update చేస్తుంది. Remember: Forward Pass Predict చేస్తుంది; Backpropagation Gradients Calculate చేస్తుంది; Optimizer Changes Apply చేస్తుంది.
questions.figure:
01 · Learning from error

A learner doesn’t just hear “wrong”—it gets an adjustment signal

The gradient tells us how the loss changes with a parameter; the optimizer decides the update. Numbers here are illustrative, not a measured training run.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: B. Backpropagation ప్రతి Trainable Parameterకి Loss Gradient Compute చేస్తుంది. Optimizer Gradients Use చేసి Weights, Biases Adjust చేస్తుంది. Initial Prediction, Optimizer Step Both Separate Stages.

questions.stem: Multiple Hidden Layers ఉన్న Neural Network Trainingలో Backpropagation ఎందుకు Important? Wrong Predictionకి Each Weight, Bias ఎంత Contribute చేశాయో ఎలా Calculate చేస్తుంది?
options: Every Weightకి Same Adjustment ఇస్తుందంటుంది. Different Connections Lossని Different Amountsలో Affect చేస్తాయి.
Last Layer మాత్రమే Check చేసి Hidden Parameters Freeze చేస్తుందంటుంది. Earlier Weights Also Outputsని Affect చేస్తాయి.
One Incorrect Predictionకి Entire Hidden Layer Replace చేస్తుందంటుంది. Normal Training Existing Weightsని Update చేస్తుంది.
Chain Ruleతో Hidden Layersలో Loss Sensitivity Trace చేసి Each Weight, Biasకి Individual Gradient Calculate చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Water Filter Plantలో Different Processing Stages Sensor Readings నుంచి Quality Predict చేసే Networkని Imagine చేయండి. Early Hidden Layerలో Weight Change, Later Signals, Final Scoreని Affect చేస్తుంది. Backpropagation Chain Ruleతో ఈ Connectionsని Backward Follow చేస్తుంది. Outputకి Far Away ఉన్న Weights, Biasesకి కూడా Loss Sensitivity Calculate చేస్తుంది. Every Connectionకి Same Correction ఇవ్వడంకంటే ఇది More Useful. Gradient అంటే Mathematical Sensitivity, Literal Personal Blame Score కాదు.
questions.figure:
02 · Who contributed?

Different connections can have very different effects on the same error

A gradient describes local sensitivity of loss to a weight or bias. Unlike equal blame, backpropagation computes a distinct derivative for each parameter.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: D. Hidden Weights Subsequent Layers ద్వారా Predictionsని Affect చేస్తాయి. Chain Rule Loss Sensitivityని Backward Propagate చేసి Each Parameterకి Different Gradient ఇస్తుంది; Gradient Literal Blame కాదు.

questions.stem: Forward Pass, Actual Valuesతో Comparison, Loss Calculation, Backward Gradient Flow, Parameter Updates అనే Stepsలో Backpropagation ఎలా Work చేస్తుంది?
options: Network Prediction, Loss Measure, Backward Gradients, Optimizer Parameter Update Repeat చేస్తుంది.
Optimizer Random Weights First Change చేసి Prediction, New Examples Select చేస్తుందంటుంది. Useful Gradient Feedback Skip అవుతుంది.
Input Backward Move చేసి Weights Update తర్వాత Loss Calculate చేస్తుందంటుంది. Lossకి Before Forward Prediction Needed.
Prediction లేకుండా Loss Calculate చేసి Same Gradient Every Layerకి Copy చేస్తుందంటుంది. Actual Connectionsపై Gradients Depend అవుతాయి.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Orchardకి ఎంత Water అవసరమో Estimate చేసే Modelని Imagine చేయండి. Temperature, Soil Dataతో Prediction ఇస్తుంది — అది Forward Pass. Loss Recorded Needతో Difference Measure చేస్తుంది. Next Backpropagation Calculation Graphలో Backward Move అయ్యి Gradients Find చేస్తుంది. Finally Optimizer వాటిని Use చేసి Small Parameter Update చేస్తుంది. Many Examplesపై Cycle Repeat అవుతుంది. Order గుర్తుంచుకోండి: Predict → Loss Measure → Gradients Calculate → Weights Update.
questions.figure:
03 · The training loop

Five linked steps: predicting happens first; learning happens after loss

The network does not send inputs backward. It sends derivatives of the loss backward through the operations recorded in the forward pass.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: A. Forward Pass Output Compute; Loss Target Error Measure; Reverse Propagation Gradients Calculate; Optimizer Parameters Update. Training Dataపై Repeat అవుతుంది.

questions.stem: Calculus Chain Rule, Partial Derivatives, Activation Derivatives, Computational Graph Use చేసి Backpropagation Weights, Biasesకి Gradients ఎలా Calculate చేస్తుంది?
options: Only Final Prediction Derivative Check చేసి Hidden Activation Derivatives Ignore చేస్తుందంటుంది. Earlier Layersకి Linked Derivatives Needed.
Total Errorని All Weights మధ్య Equally Divide చేసి Gradients Assume చేస్తుందంటుంది. Parameters Effects Different.
Chain Ruleతో Connected Paths Local Derivatives Multiply చేసి Activation Slopesతో Weight, Bias Gradients Calculate చేస్తుంది.
Final Layer Derivativeని Earlier Layersకి Unchanged Copy చేస్తుందంటుంది. Different Activations, Weightsని Ignore చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Camera Sensor Brightness Estimate చేసే Simple Modelని Imagine చేయండి. Weight Change Hidden Neuronని Affect చేసి, అది Outputని Change చేస్తే Both Effects Important. Chain Rule Pathలో Local Derivatives Multiply చేసి వాటిని Combine చేస్తుంది. Activation Derivatives Neuron Response Strengthని Show చేస్తాయి. Example: L=(wx−y)²/2 అయితే dL/dw=(wx−y)x. x=2, w=1, y=3 వద్ద Gradient −2. Optimizer ఇప్పుడు wని Upward Update చేయవచ్చు.
questions.figure:
04 · Chain rule and computational graphs

Trace the derivative backward through the activation and weighted connections

Per-example rule:∂L/∂Wˡ = δˡ (aˡ⁻¹)ᵀ   ·   ∂L/∂bˡ = δˡ. Gradients from branches or reused parameters sum at their common inputs.

For multiple hidden layers, propagate the loss signal with δˡ = ((Wˡ⁺¹)ᵀδˡ⁺¹) ⊙ f′(zˡ). Weight and bias gradients follow from each layer’s δ.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: C. Hidden Layerకి δˡ = ((Wˡ⁺¹)ᵀδˡ⁺¹) ⊙ f′(zˡ); ∂L/∂Wˡ = δˡ(aˡ⁻¹)ᵀ; One Exampleకి ∂L/∂bˡ=δˡ. Local Derivatives Pathsలో Multiply, Multiple Paths Contributions Add.

questions.figure:
05 · One-hidden-layer worked example

Forward arithmetic, four gradients and a measurable improvement

Verified NumPy + PyTorch program
import numpy as np, torch

x, y = 1., 1.
w1, b1, w2, b2 = 1., 0., 2., 0.
z = x*w1 + b1
h = np.maximum(z, 0.)         # ReLU
pred = h*w2 + b2
loss = .5 * (pred-y)**2       # half-MSE
d = pred-y
dw2, db2 = d*h, d
dz = d*w2*float(z > 0)
dw1, db1 = dz*x, dz

lr = .1
w1 -= lr*dw1; b1 -= lr*db1
w2 -= lr*dw2; b2 -= lr*db2
new_pred = w2*max(0., x*w1+b1)+b2
print(loss, new_pred, .5*(new_pred-y)**2)

v = [torch.tensor(a, requires_grad=True)
     for a in (1., 0., 2., 0.)]
u, c, w, bias = v
p = w*torch.relu(u*torch.tensor(1.)+c)+bias
(.5*(p-1.)**2).backward()
print([float(a.grad) for a in v])
# 0.5 1.04 0.0008  and [2, 2, 1, 1]

One step: calculate and verify

Loss before: 0.500000
Gradients: [2, 2, 1, 1]
Prediction after: 1.040000
Loss after: 0.000800
Autograd: MATCH ✓

Because the loss is half-MSE, L=½(ŷ−y)², the output gradient is ŷ−y. Plain MSE without the ½ factor yields gradients twice as large.

This is a fully worked one-hidden-neuron network, not a generic placeholder. The NumPy gradients were checked against PyTorch autograd.

Gradients (2,2,1,1). Learning Rate 0.1 Update తర్వాత Prediction 1.04, New Half-MSE 0.0008. Diagram NumPy, PyTorch Autograd Initial Gradients Compare చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: PyTorch Reverse-Mode Automatic Differentiationతో Backpropagation ఎలా Work చేస్తుంది? Computation Graph, Jacobian Chain Rule, Vector-Jacobian Products, Gradient Accumulation, In-Place Operations పాత్ర ఏమిటి?
options: CNN Filters Many Positionsలో Reuse అయినా All Uses Gradients Contribute చేయవని అంటుంది. Shared Filterకి Contributions Add అవుతాయి.
RNN Every Time Step Private Weight Copy Update చేస్తుందంటుంది. Shared Parameters Gradients Through Time Combine అవుతాయి.
Transformers Attention, Residual Pathsకి Backward Gradients Require కావంటుంది. Their Graph Branches కూడా Differentiate అవుతాయి.
CNN Shared Filters Gradients Add; RNNs Through Time Propagate; Transformers Attention, Residual Graphs Backward Trace చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Industrial Inspection Systemలో Three Networks Use చేస్తున్నారని Think చేయండి. CNN Same Image Filter Many Positionsలో Reuse చేస్తుంది, కాబట్టి Those Uses Gradients Add అవుతాయి. RNN Sensor Sequence Process చేస్తుంది; Backpropagation Through Time Repeated Connections Through Steps Follow చేస్తుంది. Transformer Attention, Residual Paths ద్వారా Tokens Connect చేస్తుంది, Gradients Those Branchesలో Travel చేస్తాయి. Basic Rule Same: Computation Graphని Backward Follow చేసి Shared Parameters Contributions Combine చేయడం.
questions.figure:
06 · Gradients across architectures

Shared CNN filters, RNN time steps and Transformer graph branches

CNNFilter receives summed patch gradients
RNN / BPTTShared weights collect time-step gradients
TransformerAttention, MLP and residual branches contribute
Computation graphReverse chain rule follows every dependency

Each architecture uses the chain rule, but shared parameters and branching paths change where gradient contributions must be summed.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct: D. CNN Shared Kernel Many Spatial Positionsలో Use అవుతుంది, అందుకే Gradients Add. RNN Same Recurrent Weights Many Stepsలో Reuse చేస్తుంది; BPTT Dependencies Unroll, Contributions Sum చేస్తుంది; Long Sequencesలో Truncated BPTT Use చేయవచ్చు. Transformer Attention, Projection, MLP, Residual Branches Computation Graphలో Gradients Propagate చేస్తాయి. Autograd Full Jacobians Materialize చేయనవసరం లేకుండా Compute చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Very Deep Networksలో Vanishing/Exploding Gradients, Numerical Instability, Activation Memory Problemsని Residual Connections, Normalization, Gradient Clipping, Checkpointing, Mixed Precision ఎలా Reduce చేస్తాయి?
options: Residuals Gradient Paths Shorten; Normalization Stability Help; Clipping Large Gradients Limit; Checkpointing, Mixed Precision Memory Pressure Reduce చేయవచ్చు.
Clipping Vanished Gradients Restore, Checkpointing All Activations Forever Store చేస్తుందంటుంది. Clipping Limits Large, Checkpointing Recomputes.
Normalization Every Architectureకి Perfect Stability, Mixed Precision Overflow Impossible చేస్తాయంటుంది. Settings, Monitoring Still Needed.
Residuals Every Numerical Error Prevent, Clipping Automatically Memory Halve చేస్తుందంటుంది. Techniques Different Problems Solve చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Explanation: Many Layers ఉన్న Speech Recognition Network Train చేస్తున్నారని Imagine చేయండి. కొన్ని Gradients Too Small అవడంతో Early Layers Learn చేయడం Hard; మరికొన్ని Too Large అయ్యి Updates Unstable చేస్తాయి. Residual Connections, Normalization Signal Flowకి Help చేయవచ్చు. Gradient Clipping Excessively Large Gradients Limit చేస్తుంది. Memory Save చేయడానికి Checkpointing Fewer Activations Store చేసి Later Recompute చేస్తుంది; Mixed Precision Smaller Number Formats Use చేస్తుంది. Each Method Different Bottleneck Address చేస్తుంది; Loss, Gradient Size, Speed, Numerical Stability Together Monitor చేయాలి.
